static_traits.name: 林Hai Li
static_traits.social_status: 有少数同事与朋友可交流，但尚not yet向他们倾诉自己的受限感与失望；与同事关系因回避需要新语言的任务而趋于紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往相似心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性好，能自我Reflection；情绪基调偏消极与Self-doubt，描述中提及紧张与胸口发紧；对Intervention持保留但愿意尝试，合作度尚可

basic_info.main_problem: 尽管已能流利use六种语言，但持续认为自己再也without法学会更多语言，由此产生受限感与失望，进而影响工作动力与自信。
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到这些受限感正在阻碍Career development并造成困扰，因此寻求咨询；希望从检视“我without法再学会新语言”这一信念入手，逐步恢复学习新语言的自信与动力、改善工作表现与同事关系。
growth_experiences: 在约一年前达到第六门语言的流利程度后，开始出现“到达上限”的受限感与失望感；认为由于口译工作对not断学习新语言的持续要求而承受较大压力，此后逐渐体验到学习停滞、Decreased drive与Damaged confidence。
长期处在需要持续精进的新语言学习与专业表现的职业环境中，将外在绩效压力内化为对自己的高标准，遇到新语言需求时更加容易trigger受限与失败的担忧。

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough/能力有限
我的价值取决于能否not断学会更多并持续超越自己

special_situations.event: Receiving a project requiring learning a completely new language
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能继续增加新的语言能力，就说明I am not competent enough，会在工作中失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避涉及新语言的任务、拖延相关工作、转而专注已掌握的语言以暂时减轻Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我做not到，这次肯定会失败

special_situations.event: Sees colleagues or others mastering a new language relatively easily
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人学得更快更好，就证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing discussions of new projects with colleagues, avoiding occasions where comparison may occur

special_situations.event: Reviewing the achievement of having mastered six languages
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有能继续学会更多语言，现有成就才算数；否则not值得肯定
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 贬低既有成绩，只关注not足与缺陷以促使自己“继续努力”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些not算什么，我还是not够好

special_situations.event: Encountering complex grammar or a difficult pronunciation system at the beginner stage of a new language
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能很快掌握或达到之前的水平，就说明我完全学not会
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on difficulties and amplifies their impact, reduces practice or pauses tasks to avoid frustration

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a competent person who can keep growing, maintaining a sense of control and achievement in language learning
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure and being judged; fears 'reaching the ceiling' and losing worth and belonging
defense_goal: 通过回避新语言任务与拖延来降低失败风险与Anxiety
Maintains the inner rule of 'must be better' by devaluing existing achievements to gain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、随时可能暴露without能的学习者/从业者
object_relations.object_representation: Demanding and judgmental others (such as colleagues/professional environment) who may compare me with others at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师提出以小步行为实验来检验“without法再学会新语言”的信念时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将咨询介入体验为一种业绩考核式的压力（担心再次证实自己not够好）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以保留、犹疑的语气表达（如“我not确定这是否有帮助，但可以试试”），回避明确承诺，尽量模糊目标与时间表。

manifestations: 感到被职业要求“必须not断学习新语言”所束缚
担心失去对自我能力与not yet来的掌控（害怕到达上限）
outcomes: 自我评价降低与Career development受阻

manifestations: Language learning, once loved, becomes difficult and loses its excitement
把成就视为“not算数”，难以从既有成绩中获得意义感
虽有同事与朋友但not yet向其表达受限与失望
outcomes: 社会支持动员not足，Increased emotional burden
More prone to self-cycling in career dilemmas

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在会谈中多次以保留语气表达（“我not确定这会有帮助，但愿意试试”）
Highly sensitive to failure; sets goals cautiously and lowers commitments

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes the external norm 'must keep learning more languages to count as competent' as a self-requirement
在会谈中将职业要求视为not可动摇的标准，难以调节

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: 把对外部压力的not适Turning against the self，通过回避与拖延来“承受”压力
Emphasizes 'focusing on languages already known' in descriptions, to avoid external communication or seeking support

positive_force: Already fluent in six languages with previous positive learning experiences
Willing to try small-step behavioral experiments in counseling to test beliefs
Having potential social support (colleagues and friends)
能够识do nottrigger情境与自动化思维
negative_force: 将积极成就贬值、只关注not足（negate正面）
非黑即白与预测失败的思维模式加剧Self-doubt
回避与拖延新语言相关任务以短期减轻Anxiety
将外界高标准Introjection为自我价值的唯一依据，易造成持续压力
与他人比较后产生自卑与Decreased drive

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids and procrastinates on work tasks involving learning a new language
antecedent: Receiving a project requiring learning a new language
Comparison triggered by seeing others master the new language faster
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心已到达能力上限、害怕失败与被评判，形成灾难化/非黑即白的认知并negate既有成就
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪与评估情境，短期降低Anxiety、维持自尊
target_behavior.consequence: 工作动力与表现下降、错失成长机会、Tense relationships with colleagues

target_behavior.behavior: 在新语言学习相关情境中的明显Anxiety与生理紧张（胸口发紧），并伴随Self-denial的自动化思维
antecedent: Encounters difficulties when starting beginner materials in a new language
Needing to expand language reserves for work
target_behavior.core_reason: 将短期困难解释为整体失败的证据，Reinforcement“without法再学会”的核心信念
target_behavior.function: 通过减少投入或撤退来暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 学习投入减少、能力扩展受阻，进一步ReinforcementSelf-doubt与受限感
